quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongtian Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: Zhongtian's PCB copper foil business (high-frequency high-speed, ultra-thick and customised foil) shipped more than 20,000 tons of standard foil in 2025; its high-end series is in batch supply for high-end servers, industrial control and precision communication, and through long-term cooperation with leading domestic copper-clad-laminate makers its customers cover consumer electronics, automotive electronics, AI servers, AIDC power supplies, automotive boards, optical modules and switches, with customer certification of high-end products progressing. Company (2026 plan): it will focus on RTF and HVLP high-frequency high-speed copper foil, speeding R&D and scale mass production, and lay out embedded-resistor and carrier copper foil.
quarterly_data.figure: standard copper foil shipments above 20,000 tons in 2025
